comparison_rules.comparable: Both branches measured the same unit under the same boundary.
comparison_rules.incomparable: A value exists but the frozen method does not support a numerical branch-to-branch inference.
comparison_rules.unavailable: The runner did not reliably capture the value.
comparison_rules.not_used: The scoped branch action did not invoke the resource; record zero.

execution_boundary.end: The branch-local authorized accept or reject Decision returns.
excluded: Common pre-branch Submission and Verification setup.
Post-Decision replay, comparison, and receipt persistence.
execution_boundary.start: The branch-local Decision Inbox read begins.
